name: Epic Necklace of Venom
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Necklace of Venom

effects.name: Proof Against Poison
effects.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +8 : This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +8 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).

effects.name: False Life
effects.tooltip: False Life +36 : +36 Enhancement bonus to hit points.

effects.name: Protection
effects.tooltip: Protection +8 : Passive: +8 Deflection bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Insightful Assassinate
effects.tooltip: Insightful Assassinate +5 : +5 Insight bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.

effects.name: Epic Vulkoor's Cunning
effects.tooltip: Epic Vulkoor's Cunning : 2 Pieces Equipped: -20% Artifact bonus to Melee Threat Reduction +10 Artifact bonus to Melee and Ranged Power You gain On Vorpal: You apply a Vulkoorim Constitution Poison

flavor_text: Drow assassins say this necklace is infused with Vulkoor 's subtle poisons. Wearing it will make one's attack deft and lethal.

source.raw: Epic version of Necklace of Venom
